caption:
In an outdoor paved courtyard lit by daylight, a person's arm in a camouflage sleeve grips the white handle of a lime-green racket held horizontally, its strings facing the camera, while a compact red mass sits on the right side of the strings. Behind it, a man in a red cap, a dark t-shirt with yellow lettering, grey shorts and grey shoes stands facing forward with his hands clasped, holding a largely unchanged pose. Parked cars, a green building with an arch, trees and a brick building with arched windows fill the background.

The background remains broadly steady, while the hand and racket show only slight shifts, so the dominant visible change is the red mass on the strings. It already occupies a small rounded blob on the right side and, over time, progressively enlarges and deforms into a larger, irregular, frayed clump. Thin spiky tendrils radiate outward from the mass, and its overall footprint increases rather than sliding across the strings, eventually extending beyond the right rim of the green frame. The expansion is still ongoing.
